subject: general
question: Who founded the Visva Bharati which later became a Central University?
solution:
The correct answer is **Rabindranath Tagore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** founded Visva Bharati in 1921.
 
• Visva Bharati was initially established as a center for culture with the motto "Yatra Visvam Bhavatyekanidam" which means "where the world makes a home in a single nest".
 
• Tagore envisioned the university as a place where the whole world could meet in a single nest.
 
• In 1951, Visva Bharati was declared a Central University.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Sarojini Naidu was an Indian independence activist and poet. She was also the first woman to become the president of the Indian National Congress and to be appointed as a governor of an Indian state.
 
 

 Option 2
 Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a social reformer who is often called the "Father of the Indian Renaissance." He played a key role in the abolition of the practice of Sati.
 
 

 Option 3
 Rabindranath Tagore was a polymath and a Nobel laureate in Literature who founded Visva Bharati University.
 
 

 Option 4
 Sri Aurobindo was a philosopher, yogi, guru, and poet. He was also a nationalist who played a significant role in India's freedom struggle.
